upstream.author: Akihiko Koizuka and master.lib coauthors
upstream.archive_validation: Outer archive identity is rehashed; its compressed extraction is not rerun. Inner archive is independently pinned and every stored member header/checksum/CRC and extracted file is revalidated.
upstream.historic_terms: Custom/shareware; no SPDX or OSI status inferred. Archive and source remain private; no redistribution decision.

macro_context.function_wrapper_rule: Only remove CALLMODEL from name proc CALLMODEL inside complete func and retfunc macros; EVEN/ENDP and all other lines remain literal.
macro_context.limitation: Original macro source is not separately assembled; native context equivalence is backed by preserved large-model listing, actual OMF/link reconstruction and complete original raw comparison.

No authored bytes are granted and no ownership or denominator decision is made.
